stem:
Aarav times a toy car moving along a straight track. In each equal 2 s interval it covers 40 cm, 40 cm, and 40 cm.

How should this straight-line motion be classified?

options.text: Uniform linear motion, because equal distances are covered in equal time intervals.
Non-uniform linear motion, because equal distances in equal times mean the speed is changing.
Uniform linear motion, even if the distances in equal times were 40 cm, 25 cm, and 55 cm.
Non-uniform linear motion, because any motion on a track is non-uniform.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal distances in equal times on a straight line mean uniform linear motion. Calling that pattern non-uniform, or keeping the uniform label when distances differ, miss that hinge.
